summary: Baileys fork: static keyword co-occurrence without traced installer harm
details: Package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library. A a static rule matched on keyword co-occurrence (the token 'ping' at lib/Utils/generics.js:403 alongside 'GET' and 'id' tokens elsewhere in the file), but semantic context is consistent with normal library behavior in this class of package (WebSocket keepalive/ping and HTTP GETs to WhatsApp endpoints as part of the documented protocol). No hardcoded non-first-party exfiltration endpoint, no credential/env scraping, no install-time lifecycle script fetching remote code, no dropper, and no backdoor were identified in the flagged file or its surroundings. The match is a weak keyword co-occurrence pattern in a large protocol-implementation codebase.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
